test_look_at_view_transform: test look_at_view_transform to create camera rotation and translation from eye, at, and up vectors
test_camera_to_eye_at_up: test camera_to_eye_at_up to invert a world-to-view transform back into eye, at, and up vectors
test_rotate_on_spot_yaw: test rotate_on_spot to yaw a camera left or right around the y axis in place
test_rotate_on_spot_pitch: test rotate_on_spot to pitch a camera up or down around the x axis in place
test_PerspectiveCameras: test PerspectiveCameras to construct a perspective camera from rotation matrix R and translation vector T
